title: HSWall 솔로 #023 · 머슬아워글래스BBW · Portuguese azulejo tile · 나무 판자 벽 직접 고정 · inner ends and her lips
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 2:3 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in an old timber dungeon with a wall of thick rough dark oak planks behind her, a low beamed wooden ceiling, iron torch sconces with flickering flames on the wall, old iron tools hanging on the wall, a worn plank floor, dark and moody firelight, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking in from one side, sharp focus from head to toe, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Subject: ONE real adult Hawaiian woman in her late 30s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a natural glowing complexion, a flower tucked behind one ear, warm golden-tan skin, a hint of quiet misery, her brows tilted up slightly at the inner ends and her lips pressed together, low bun hair, real living eyes. Long oval nails, glossy finish.

Physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. Huge rounded shoulders and thick, powerfully muscular arms with the swell of the muscle visible beneath a soft layer, a colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in clearly even at this size. Below that waistline a great mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle and drops down under its own weight, gathering into two or three heavy rounded folds, never taut, never smooth, never round like a drum, not pregnant. Enormous round hips more than three times the width of that waistline, colossal thighs with a muscular sweep visible beneath the fat, thick heavy calves. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Skin: Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a smooth taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh folds, faint stretch marks where the great curves have expanded. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Body Art: Her bare skin is painted in Portuguese azulejo tile — a brilliant white ground with deep cobalt-blue floral borders, wide cobalt bands following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs like contour lines, dense repeating panel scrollwork filling the space between every band. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every bulge. The paint covers her body below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of her hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of her feet. Her face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line. The paint has worn thin in broad patches over her upper back, hips and calves and chipped off in small flakes at her wrists and ankles, the living skin showing through the faded pattern. Dust and soot streak her temples and jaw, her lipstick is faded and smudged, dark smears run along her ribs, arms and shins, and her bare feet are filthy with dust and dirt.

Restraints: Her wrists wear heavy medieval hinged wrought-iron fetters, wide rough-forged iron bands closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, each with a heavy iron ring, each ring fixed directly onto a heavy iron plate bolted flat to the plank wall high above her head on its own side, a little wider apart than her shoulders, the cuffs sitting snug against the plate, her arms stretched straight up. Her ankles wear heavy medieval hinged wrought-iron fetters, wide rough-forged iron bands closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, each with a heavy iron ring, each ring fixed directly onto a heavy iron plate bolted flat to the plank wall just above the floor on its own side, the cuffs sitting snug against the plate, her feet shoulder-width apart.

Pose: standing with her back pressed flat against the plank wall, facing the camera, her arms stretched straight up with her hands hanging limp and loose from the cuffs, her bare feet shoulder-width apart flat on the floor, her head tipped slightly forward, her whole body sagging with fatigue, her chest, shoulders and stomach fully in view.

Footwear: bare feet flat on the floor, the soles, toes and tops of her feet streaked with soot and dirt.

Background & Lighting: the dim light catching the painted pattern in sharp glints, carving every fold and curve.

Vertical 2:3 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide. portrait 2:3 vertical.
